def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; comps=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if seen[i][j]: continue
            c=grid[i][j]; comp=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; st=[(i,j)]
            while st:
                y,x=st.pop()
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and not seen[ny][nx] and grid[ny][nx]==c:
                        seen[ny][nx]=True; comp.append((ny,nx)); st.append((ny,nx))
            comps.append((c,comp))
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    shapes=[(c,(min(y for y,x in co),min(x for y,x in co),max(y for y,x in co),max(x for y,x in co)))
            for c,co in comps if len(co)>=2]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for c,co in comps:
        if len(co)!=1: continue
        y,x=co[0]
        votes=Counter(sc for sc,(t,l,b,r) in shapes if t<=y<=b and l<=x<=r)
        out[y][x]=votes.most_common(1)[0][0] if votes else bg
    return out

print(transform(G['Test input']))

def components(grid, conn4=True):
    """Same-color connected components as (color, cells) pairs (4- or 8-connected)."""
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; out=[]
    offs=((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if conn4 else ((dy,dx) for dy in(-1,0,1) for dx in(-1,0,1) if dy or dx)
    for i in range(h):

                        seen[ny][nx]=True; comp.append((ny,nx)); st.append((ny,nx))
            out.append((c,comp))
    return out

def background(grid):
    """The most common color in the grid."""
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

def bboxes(grid, min_size=2):
    """Bounding boxes (top,left,bottom,right) of non-background components of at least min_size cells, with their color."""
    bg=background(grid)
    return [(c,(min(y for y,x in co),min(x for y,x in co),max(y for y,x in co),max(x for y,x in co)))
            for c,co in components(grid) if len(co)>=min_size and c!=bg]

def fill_noise(grid):
    """Isolated single cells inside a shape's bounding box take the shape's color; other isolated cells become the background."""
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=background(grid); shapes=bboxes(grid)

        out[y][x]=votes.most_common(1)[0][0] if votes else bg
